'''Barry's Empoleon''' (Japanese: '''ジュンのエンペルト''' ''Jun's Emperte'') is {{an|Barry}}'s main battling Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==History==
[[File:DP101.png|thumb|left|220px|Empoleon battling Ash's Pikachu]]
Empoleon debuted in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]''. Barry sent it out to battle {{TRT}} after they were responsible for setting up a fake {{pkmn|Storage System}} where they could steal Trainers' Pokémon. It managed to send {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} flying. Barry then mentioned that the same exact {{m|Hydro Cannon|move}} was the cause for his victory over [[James's Cacnea|Gardenia's Cacnea]] after a long, hard-fought battle, despite Cacnea having the type advantage. However, this was cut short as the trio was sent flying from Empoleon's {{m|Hyper Beam}} with the combined effort of {{AP|Pikachu}}'s and {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}'s attacks.

Later, Empoleon was the last Pokémon sent out during Barry's battle against Ash after both sides lost two Pokémon. Even though Empoleon had the type disadvantage, it managed to hang in there long. However, Empoleon was defeated by Pikachu's {{m|Volt Tackle}} as it couldn't dodge due to the [[recharge]] effect of Hyper Beam.

In ''[[DP102|A Shield with a Twist!]]'', it was revealed that Empoleon had trained with Barry in [[Iron Island]] before they defeated [[Byron]]. It also appeared in ''[[DP103|Jumping Rocket Ship!]]'' where Barry sent it out to get its picture taken along with the group as Barry did not want any of his other Pokémon to have their picture taken, only for it to fall into Team Rocket's pitfall traps as the photographers turned out to be the villains themselves. During the battle, after its Hydro Pump and {{AP|Chimchar}}'s {{m|Flamethrower}} collided with Carnivine's {{m|Bullet Seed}} barrage and Seviper's {{m|Haze}} and sent them flying, Empoleon got separated with [[Brock's Happiny]], Dawn's Piplup, and [[Ash's Grotle]]. It, along with the other Pokémon, eventually got reunited with their Trainers.
[[File:Barry and Empoleon.png|thumb|left|250px|Empoleon and Barry]]
Empoleon was seen {{pkmn|training}} with Barry and {{p|Heracross}} on [[Iron Island]] in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]''. Their training was cut short when [[Team Galactic]]'s machine caused it to go reckless, due to it being part {{type|Steel}}. It later appeared in ''[[DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!]]'' with its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, where it was freed from Team Galactic's control. Empoleon and Barry then bid Ash and {{ashfr}} farewell.

Empoleon briefly appeared in ''[[DP122|Stopped in the Name of Love!]]''. In ''[[DP124|To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!]]'', it competed in the [[Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament]] with Barry. Both of them managed to get far in the tournament until they went up against [[O]] and his {{p|Shiftry}}, whom they lost to.
[[File:Barry Empoleon Torrent.png|thumb|250px|{{a|Torrent}} activated]]
In ''[[DP141|Challenging a Towering Figure!]]'', Empoleon was used in the [[Festival Battle Challenge]], a tournament marking the end of the [[Twinleaf Festival]] whose winner gets a chance to battle [[Palmer]]. Barry was hoping to have a battle with his father. However, he and Empoleon lost to Ash and his Pikachu in the final round.

After Ash caught a {{AP|Gible}} in ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]'', Empoleon challenged him. It won as Empoleon had a large advantage against Gible. This gave Barry his first victory over Ash. It appeared again in ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'', where it battled an unnamed Trainer's {{p|Mothim}}. Afterward, Empoleon started a battle with Ash's Monferno after [[Paul]] told him to battle Ash. Both sides managed to stay in sync despite Monferno's type-disadvantage. However, Empoleon's Hydro Cannon sent it flying, which resulted in the activating of {{a|Blaze}}. As a result, the battle had no conclusion.

In ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', Empoleon got Barry through the preliminaries of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] after defeating another Trainer's {{p|Nosepass}}. In ''[[DP184|Casting a Paul on Barry!]]'', it was Barry's final Pokémon in his battle against Paul. It battled [[Paul's Magmortar]], where it managed to serve some damage to Magmortar only for Magmortar to survive the attack. Both sides then recalled their Pokémon. It was sent out again to fight against [[Paul's Ursaring]], where it was able to hit a {{m|Focus Blast}} back to Ursaring before Paul recalled Ursaring for his newly evolved {{TP|Paul|Electivire}}. Empoleon eventually activated {{a|Torrent}} after a long battle and then used {{m|Hydro Cannon}}. However, Electivire used {{m|Protect}} and then attacked with a powerful {{m|Thunder}}, making Empoleon faint standing up and causing Barry to lose the battle.

Empoleon briefly appeared alongside Barry during the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''.

==Personality and characteristics==
Empoleon is considered to be Barry's most trusted Pokémon as it managed to defeat many Gyms that Barry challenged. It has even held its ground against stronger opponents, especially the ones with the type advantage. Since Barry uses Empoleon in almost every single one of his battles, it is used to battling alongside him and is always willing to do so.

Empoleon, while completely loyal to Barry, sometimes shows embarrassment with its Trainer's behavior, shown when it sighed in exasperation after Barry lost his cool over not catching a Gible.
